messages.body: DL-043 has one pallet at Orris Span Fabrication, but its dimensions and weight fields are blank. We cannot allocate a collection vehicle from an unspecified pallet size.
We have the pallet ready. Please tell me which measurements the carrier needs to finish the booking.
Please provide measured length, width and total height including pallet, plus gross weight including packaging, for DL-043. We will pass those actual measurements to the carrier.
Measured DL-043: 120 × 100 × 145 cm including pallet, gross weight 310 kg including packaging. One non-stackable pallet; our calibrated warehouse scale supplied the weight.
Update on DL-043. After I measured, production added another layer of cartons to the pallet. It is now taller than 145 cm and heavier than 310 kg. I have not re-measured or re-weighed it yet.

The values of 120 x 100 x 145 cm and 310 kg no longer describe DL-043, so we will not send them to the carrier. Please re-measure the total height including pallet and re-weigh the gross weight including packaging as the pallet now stands, and confirm the length and width.

Re-measured DL-043 as built: 120 x 100 x 168 cm including pallet, gross weight 352 kg including packaging, from our calibrated warehouse scale. Still one non-stackable pallet. These are our figures; the carrier has not checked them or allocated a vehicle.
